==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* Represented South Korea at the [[IeSF 8th e-Sports World Championship]].
* Was suspended during [[LCK 2018 Spring]] and had to complete 20 hours of public service for making suicide-related jokes in solo queue.<ref>[https://www.facebook.com/AfreecaFreecs/posts/1764706306926310 Afreeca Freecs' Facebook Post (Korean)] ''facebook.com''</ref>
* Reached 1000 kills in the LCK on July 6, 2022.
** Is the 19th player to reach 1000 kills in the LCK, after [[Faker]], [[PraY]], [[Bang]], [[Score]], [[Kuro]], [[Smeb]], [[Ambition]], [[Sangyoon]], [[Deft]], [[Teddy]], [[Ruler]], [[Bdd]], [[Ghost (Jang Yong-jun)|Ghost]], [[Peanut]], [[Chovy]], [[Fly (Song Yong-jun)|Fly]], [[ShowMaker]], and [[Kiin]].
* Reached 1500 kills in the LCK on July 7, 2023.
** The 12th player to reach 1500 kills in the LCK after [[Faker]], [[PraY]], [[Bang]], [[Score]], [[Kuro]], [[Deft]], [[Ruler]], [[Teddy]], [[Bdd]], [[Chovy]], and [[Peanut]].
* Reached 2000 kills in the LCK on June 27, 2024.
** The 7th player to reach 2000 kills in the LCK after [[Faker]], [[Deft]], [[Ruler]], [[Teddy]], [[Bdd]], and [[Chovy]]
** His 2000th kill was on [[Nongshim RedForce|NS]]'s Top Laner [[DnDn]] in the [[LCK/2024 Season/Summer Season|LCK 2024 Summer]] with {{ci|Kalista}}
* Reached 2500 kills in the LCK on August 01, 2025.
** The 4th player to reach 2500 kills in the LCK after [[Faker]], [[Deft]], and [[Bdd]].
* Reached 500 games in the LCK on July 27, 2024, becoming the 19th player to do so.
* Reached 600 games in the LCK on August 24, 2025, becoming the 14th player to do so.
* Reached 300 wins in [[LCK]] on April 20, 2025, becoming the 19th player to do so.
* Set a new record for most kills in one (LCK) split with 301 kills in [[LCK 2024 Summer]], beating the previous record of 234 kills set by [[Peyz]] a year before.

{{PlayerStatsTrivia}}
=== Individual Awards ===
* LCK 1st All-Pro Team x1 (Summer 2023)
* LCK 3rd All-Pro Team x2 (Summer 2022, Summer 2024)
